name: StableTravel
summary: Pay-per-request travel data for agents (flight prices and booking links, award seat availability, live flight tracking, hotels, activities and transfers) over x402 or MPP, with no account; part of the Merit Systems AgentCash family of services.

key_number.unit: calls in 30 days (CDP Bazaar quality data)

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (20:24-20:59 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with StableTravel or YourAITools is involved.

claims.statement: https://stabletravel.dev is the official site: it is the address YourAITools lists for StableTravel and the site answers there (page title "StableTravel").
The site serves real content without sign-in (HTTP 200). It also publishes an llms.txt for agents.
claims.quote: Pay-per-request access to flights, award availability, hotels, activities, and transfers. No auth, no subscriptions.

claims.statement: Operator's own description: Pay-per-request access to flights, award availability, hotels, activities, and transfers. No auth, no subscriptions.
claims.quote: Pay-per-request access to flights, award availability, hotels, activities, and transfers. No auth, no subscriptions.

claims.statement: Operated by Merit Systems (the site's terms link to merit.systems; it is onboarded through Merit's AgentCash).
Public documentation for agents and developers.

Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid GET to https://stabletravel.dev/api/google-flights/search answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Base, Solana; asset USDC; price 0.02 USDC; payTo Base 0xDd257723b86B4947483905cdAcBbBC70fACF2ec0; Solana 6u5LMGQC2qk9peNibahmRWxGVXrBypk8nhTCcqtiuqMY). YourAITools lists the price as $0.01–$0.02. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works. The probed route is not the cheapest one listed.
methods: unpaid GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/google-flights/search (HTTP 402, header:payment-required; no payment header sent)

claims.statement: Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (the CDP facilitator's discovery index) lists 124 resource(s) on this vendor's domain for the payTo address(es) we observed, with 6,378 calls in the last 30 days as reported by CDP (largest single resource: 19 unique payers; payers cannot be de-duplicated across resources). These are the facilitator's counts, not an Atlas observation of settlements.
